text:
isabel: quick callout — finalizing JS SDK fetch approach. proposal: prefer globalThis.fetch when present, dynamic import('undici') as Node fallback, and an env override SDK_FETCH to force path in CI. goal: avoid packaging ESM/CJS shims for users.

harry: +1. also expose createSdkFetch({ auth, retry, envOverride, fetch? }) so tests can inject a fake fetch and auth/retry wrapping is consistent.

dawn: types note: publish a tiny types/fetch-shim.d.ts and set `types` in package.json to point at it. docs should say: if TS errors mention DOM types, add "lib": ["DOM"] or use our shim.

isabel: packaging: use conditional exports to keep undici out of edge bundles; mark undici as optionalDependency for our server build artifact. add example for Next app/edge vs pages/api.

ops-bot: CI: fetch-adapter-matrix (node18,node20,deno,vercel-edge) triggered.

harry: i'll open helper + env-override PR. dawn will add types/shim + docs. isabel will update package.json exports. thanks! :thumbsup:
